}}'''Clarine Anhill''' is a dog trainer in [[Valan Luca]] [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|traveling show]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Clarine Anhill}} She is married to [[Petra Anhill]].

==Appearance==
She is plump and has brown cheeks.

==Activities==
In addition to training the dogs,{{ref/book|5|17}} Clarine is also a seamstress. She makes a very low-cut dress for [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] when she and [[Elayne Trakand]] are traveling with the show. Clarine is very tight with whatever coin she receives, as she and her husband intend to open an inn. [[Matrim Cauthon]], having found out about this, gives her and Petra a purse of gold before he leaves to help them in their endeavor.
